name: Cassette Publish
tagline: Publish browser games to Cassette from a coding agent
description: Publish and manage browser games on Cassette through a hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server at https://cassette.gg/mcp/publish. OAuth sign-in and human approval are required. Documentation: https://cassette.gg/agents/guide.md. The server is vendor-hosted; its implementation is not public source.

install.notes: Sign in and approve the client on Cassette when prompted.
